chaining: A box that keeps its filesystem and runs an MCP server is the piece a stateless sandbox lacks: an agent reconnects over SSH or HTTPS by hostname and finds its tools and caches still installed, so the setup cost is paid once a month rather than once a run.

limits.value: The 100 GB monthly egress and the single guaranteed vCPU are the terms that bind: the second vCPU is best-effort on host spare capacity, and the box sleeps when idle so a background job that needs a warm box has to keep it awake.

notes: Recorded as paid-only rather than trial-only because no free lane was found on the pages reached. The hosted cloud console at cloud.containarium.dev answered with a login wall behind scripts (broker read reported login-wall, status 409), so a trial, if one exists, is invisible without an account; that is the open question and an account is what would settle it. The core is Apache 2.0 and self-hostable, which is not a price but does mean the same box can run on any rented VM. At USD 20 for 1 guaranteed vCPU and 4 GiB this is the cheapest flat-rate agent box found in this lane after RemoteHost's per-hour arithmetic.
